records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales in the three months ended September 30, 2022 increased $13.0 million, or 12.0%, to $121.4 million from $108.4 million in the three months ended September 30, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in net sales for the three months ended September 30, 2022 was primarily due to higher pricing compared to prior periods, partially offset by a decline in sales volume primarily with direct ship customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of September 30, 2022, the Company had committed to purchase green coffee inventory totaling $103.6 million under fixed-price contracts, and $12.3 million in inventory and other purchases under non-cancelable purchase orders.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Unit sales decreased 11.4% and average unit price increased by 26.4% in the three months ended September 30, 2022 as compared to the same period in the prior fiscal year, resulting in an increase in our net sales of 12.0%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used in operating activities during the three months ended September 30, 2022 was $13.4 million as compared to $6.7 million in the three months ended September 30, 2021.
